summary: Zentek Ltd. filed a Form 6-K disclosing a material change report dated August 20, 2026, announcing the results of a Preliminary Economic Assessment for its Albany Graphite Project. The PEA includes economic highlights such as after-tax NPV of US$3,854.5M and an IRR of 27.4%. This is an operational update and not a special-situation corporate event. The filing is a routine current report under Rule 13a-16 and does not involve any M&A, restructuring, capital return, or similar transaction. Accordingly, no special-situations category applies.
